sentence_stem: Although the agreement has been signed,
correct_completion: the parties may still negotiate its terms.
full_sentence: Although the agreement has been signed, the parties may still negotiate its terms.
acceptable_variants: the parties can still amend the conditions.
the terms remain open to further negotiation.

options.text: so the parties no longer have any obligations.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result of a cause. 'Although' requires a contrasting clause, not a consequence.

options.text: because the agreement was signed in June.
options.why_wrong: 'Because' introduces a reason. The sentence needs a contrast with the signing, not an explanation of when or why it occurred.

options.text: the agreement was drafted by a lawyer.
options.why_wrong: This adds background information but does not complete the contrast started by 'although'.

options.text: the parties may still negotiate its terms.

grammar_focus: Concessive clauses with 'although' (contrast with a completed legal action)
explanation: After 'although', the clause must show a contrast with the signing of the agreement. Continued negotiation contrasts with a signed contract.
translation: Chociaż umowa została podpisana, strony mogą nadal negocjować jej warunki.
